title: Audit: make KRN delivery cheaper than plain git+gh
body:
Operator 2026-11-06 ~23:00Z: "nie uważasz że normalnie bez krn lepiej się pracuje niż z krn? musisz zrobić audyt i tak ogarnąć system żeby realnie lepiej się pracowało z krn niż normalnie" and "Naprawiaj wszystko, musisz penetrować to do tego stopnia żeby Ci się zajebiście dobrze pracowało".
Goal: KRN delivery must be measurably cheaper than plain git+gh+tests. Metric: wall-clock and lead tokens from "change ready" to "merged + main green" for a one-file fix; plain baseline ~15 min.
Evidence from the 2026-11-06 session (t-9czzfve, a ~20-line ship fix) that took ~3 h of lead time:
1. Orphaned Jenkins krn/gate blocked Product ship (fixed in GLOBAL #477, sealed #478 = b41faae, NOT installed).
2. Host install blocked: ~/.codex/AGENTS.md and ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md are operator-owned files, six ~/.agents/skills KRN links were removed; `krn install apply` exits 73 (foreign collision). Workaround used: PATH shim `krn` -> GLOBAL checkout at b41faae for `krn deliver`. Decide: retire managed AGENTS.md/skills from the GLOBAL manifest or port ship into Product so legacy forwarding is not on the delivery path.
3. GLOBAL CI still on Jenkins (required gate (fast)/(deep), app 5548482): no webhook delivery (manual branch-indexing scans via tunnel), gate (fast) flaky "session pids limit probe" on the first build. Blocks Jenkins/PVE decommission t-sdcdxb2.
4. GLOBAL judges krn/judge-standards/spec must be posted by hand from the review record; Product deliver refuses a GLOBAL PR (exit 71 Node pin).
5. Review red-first sandbox leaks task slots (t-g1nr12w) -> false head=assertion.
6. GLOBAL quality:audit fails on a dynamically imported export ("dead export").
7. Main CI flake family t-r69gyb7 hit again (codex-usage-completeness "Codex startup cancelled before registration"), needed gh run rerun.
8. Two repos, two trackers of truth, two delivery CLIs; the lead reads huge JSON blobs (review output, Jenkins HTML) by default.
Do: an audit of every step a lead takes for a one-file fix (enumerate mechanically; time each), compare to plain git/gh, then delete or automate every step that does not catch real defects. Candidates: one CLI for both repos, ship inside Product, Actions for GLOBAL, review prints a one-line verdict, deliver posts judge statuses for any repo, flake quarantine.

Operator 2026-11-07 (verbatim): "Potem najważniejsze jest porównanie t3 headless i badanie AB ale najpierw ogarnij te wszystkie najważniejsze rzeczy.." and "musimy udowodnic ze lepszy niz przy normalnej pracy". Next after the current batch: headless A/B on the same task set, arms KRN lead vs plain git+gh vs T3 headless (t3 thread start --wait), metrics wall time, USD/tokens, defects reaching main, red Check rounds; reuse .krn/runs/lead/t3-ab/ harness.
